beats.text: Mang Ernesto asks: Where can we confirm the health activity information? Vlanche has heard the same question from other residents. First, she listens.
Provincial and City Health Boards oversee UHC integration. A BHW is not automatically a member. Vlanche asks the health team for the appropriate local contact.
She summarises what she heard: a recurring question, conflicting information, and details still to confirm. The summary has no names or personal health details.
As a barangay HEPO, Vlanche checks the message with the team. She explains it simply, invites questions, and checks the resident’s understanding.
She practises with the midwife: Who can confirm and receive the suggestion? Who can decide? She does not promise that her idea is approved.
They agree when and how to follow up. She will share only confirmed feedback. The BHW contributes observation, accurate messaging, coordination and follow-up.
